adjusted_price_candles_prices_check.name: adjusted_price_candles_prices_check
adjusted_price_candles_prices_check.value:
"adjusted_price_candles"."low" > 0 AND "adjusted_price_candles"."low" <= "adjusted_price_candles"."high"
    AND "adjusted_price_candles"."open" BETWEEN "adjusted_price_candles"."low" AND "adjusted_price_candles"."high"
    AND "adjusted_price_candles"."close" BETWEEN "adjusted_price_candles"."low" AND "adjusted_price_candles"."high"

price_candles_prices_check.name: price_candles_prices_check
price_candles_prices_check.value:
"price_candles"."low" > 0 AND "price_candles"."low" <= "price_candles"."high"
    AND "price_candles"."open" BETWEEN "price_candles"."low" AND "price_candles"."high"
    AND "price_candles"."close" BETWEEN "price_candles"."low" AND "price_candles"."high"

quotes_delay_minutes_check.name: quotes_delay_minutes_check
quotes_delay_minutes_check.value:
("quotes"."freshness" = 'delayed' AND "quotes"."delay_minutes" IS NOT NULL
        AND "quotes"."delay_minutes" > 0)
        OR ("quotes"."freshness" <> 'delayed' AND "quotes"."delay_minutes" IS NULL)

fundamental_ratios_trace_sources_check.name: fundamental_ratios_trace_sources_check
fundamental_ratios_trace_sources_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("fundamental_ratios"."calc_trace" -> 'input' -> 'sources') = 'array'
        THEN jsonb_array_length("fundamental_ratios"."calc_trace" -> 'input' -> 'sources') > 0
        ELSE FALSE END

news_sentiment_method_check.name: news_sentiment_method_check
news_sentiment_method_check.value: "news"."sentiment" IS NULL OR "news"."sentiment_method" IS NOT NULL

alert_events_value_provenance_check.name: alert_events_value_provenance_check
alert_events_value_provenance_check.value: "alert_events"."observed_value" IS NULL OR ("alert_events"."observed_currency" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("alert_events"."observed_currency") <> '' AND "alert_events"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)
